sketch.name: CashFlowChart
sketch.description: A 13-week cash forecast: weekly inflow columns above the zero line, outflow columns below, a net line, a running cash balance line against a minimum-cash line, with weeks below the minimum highlighted.
sketch.html:
Ending
Lowest

props.name: title
props.description: The chart's name, shown in the header.

props.name: weeks
props.description: The weeks in order: week label, inflow and outflow (both positive).

props.name: openingBalance
props.description: Cash balance at the start of the first week.

props.name: minimumCash
props.description: The minimum cash policy; weeks whose balance is below it are highlighted.

props.name: selected
props.description: The selected week (its label); empty for none.
